title: sail registry entry: one repository on this machine
description: <machine dir>/watchers/<name>.json: written by every command that opens a run, and read by the dashboard to find the repository's runs. Keyed by project.yaml's name. The remote is stripped of any userinfo. A live watcher adds its own field.

sailDir.description: the repository's .sail/, absolute; .sail-runs/ sits beside it

watcher.description: the repository's live watcher, written as it starts and cleared as it stops: its pid, when it started, the .sail/ it watches, the ticket source's adapter and the labels it polls there. A watcher whose pid is dead is none
